name: sdlc-skills
description: One plugin for coding agents: sdlc builds a change from what and why you agree to a reviewed merge, with hooks that decide when it is done and house rules for how the agent works with you.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Whoever made a change, someone else attacks it, and a machine decides when it is done: a build skill that agrees with you what to build and why, one testable criterion per business rule and a design you work out together, for a feature, a bug or a refactor, has the design reviewed, writes failing tests first, has fresh agents implement, review and verify, then merges or opens a pull request, a ticket skill that writes a short story, bug or spike down for later, and a spike skill for throwaway experiments; plus hooks for a done check that runs every test and the linter, an AGENTS.md size cap, a dependency gate, a pull request size cap, an acceptance gate that refuses a push, pull request or merge until each criterion in the red commit has a test and the definition of done passes, and gates on commits that leave in debugging leftovers or switch a checker off. At session start, a hook adds house rules for how the agent works with you, and a delegator agent runs non-coding tasks in parallel.
